h: Gombe Assembly reportedly approves the creation of a state police force
p: Lawmakers in Gombe State have reportedly voted to back the creation of a state police force. The move follows wider national debate on decentralising policing amid insecurity concerns.
more: Several state assemblies have been weighing similar backing.
Federal approval would still be needed for any change.
